newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks stumble to sharply lower close.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks stumble to sharply lower close.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks fell to a sharply lower close on Monday, prompted by a drop on Wall Street and weakness in the local property market, brokers said.
"It (market weakness) is due to a combination of concerns about the property market and Wall Street," said Janet Gillies, sales director at OCBC Securities.
The Hang Seng Index closed 220.63 points, or 1.76 percent, lower at 12,295.97, after clawing back some ground from an afternoon low of 12,264.76.
Turnover was HK$7.64 billion, well down from Friday's HK$9.33 billion.
